text: え……　そんなに　タマゴを　かえしたの……　その　タマゴすきっぷりは　いったい　どうなのー　おっ　おもしろすぎるなあー　きみ！

structure.jp: そんなに　タマゴを　かえしたの……
その　タマゴすきっぷりは　いったい　どうなのー
structure.en: what on earth is with that Egg-loving of yours?

structure.jp: おっ　おもしろすぎるなあー　きみ！

patterns.name: 〜っぷり
patterns.explanation: っぷり added to a word means 'the way or degree of' it, often with amazement. タマゴすきっぷり = 'how much you love Eggs'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a sentence makes a soft, casual question; after どう it becomes なの. かえしたの = 'you hatched them?'.

patterns.name: 〜すぎる
patterns.explanation: すぎる added to a describing word (after dropping its い) means 'too much'. おもしろすぎる = 'too funny'.
